children: Shares of discount broking firm Angel One Ltd. will be in focus on Friday, September 4, after the company released its business update for August 2026.

Angel One's average daily orders has declined month-on-month in August. However, its gross client additions and SIP registrations rose to six-month highs, while the average client funding book reached another all-time high.

Angel One's average daily orders has declined 11% from last month to 5.21 million. The company's average client funding book stood at ₹7,421 crore in August, up 4.8% from July and 40.2% higher than the year-ago period.
The company's client base grew 1.4% month-on-month to 39.56 million, while gross client additions rose to 0.57 million from 0.47 million in July.
Angel One's average daily turnover (ADTO) stood at ₹3.151 lakh crore, up 55.1% month-on-month. Equity F&O premium turnover, however, declined 15.6% from July to ₹11,300 crore.
Commodity segment ADTO grew 62.6% month-on-month to ₹2.956 lakh crore, while Angel One's market share in the segment declined 428 basis points to 43.7%.
The broking firm's cash market share declined 158 basis points month-on-month to 17%, while its F&O market share fell 48 basis points to 21.7%.
Of the 12 analysts covering Angel One, 10 have a 'Buy' rating, while two have a 'Hold' call on the stock.
Shares of Angel One ended 2.4% higher at ₹285.95 on Thursday. The stock is up more than 20% so far this year.

title: Angel One shares in focus on daily orders drop in August, SEBI CAS circular
